# Creed Handyman LLC

> Licensed (#8145054) and insured (Hiscox general liability) handyman service in Wichita, Kansas, serving all of Sedgwick County since 2022. Owner-operated by Bernard Reed. Free estimates; $55/hour with a two-hour minimum; $80 house-call special inside Wichita city limits. Phone (316) 400-7414.

Specialties: interior painting and drywall, vacant-unit make-ready turnovers, work orders and punch lists for landlords and property managers, flooring (carpet tear-out, vinyl and laminate plank), trash-outs and cleanouts, plus plumbing, electrical, doors and locks, and mounting/assembly. Rated 5.0 by customers on Angi/HomeAdvisor. Hours: Mon–Fri 9 AM–7 PM, Sat 9 AM–12 PM, closed Sunday.

## Service areas
Wichita, Derby, Haysville, Park City, Bel Aire, Valley Center, Maize, Goddard, Kechi, Cheney, Clearwater, Colwich, Andale, Garden Plain, Mount Hope, Bentley (Sedgwick County, Kansas).
